headline: Ecopipam enters a generic-dominated market as the first novel mechanism in over a decade — but the real competition is therapeutic conservatism and cheap generics, not a branded rival.

algorithm.title: AAN 2019 treatment ladder

rungs.label: Watchful waiting
rungs.note: The largest de facto 'competitor' — most tics are mild, wax-and-wane, and improve with age.

rungs.label: CBIT (behavioral)
rungs.note: Guideline-preferred; ~52.5% respond vs 18.5% control, but access is throttled by a therapist shortage.

rungs.label: Alpha-2 agonists (guanfacine, clonidine)
rungs.for: Mild-moderate tics, esp. with comorbid ADHD
rungs.note: Off-label first-line pharmacotherapy; cheap generics; treat both tics and ADHD. AAN Level B.

rungs.label: Antipsychotics (D2 blockers)
rungs.note: The only 3 FDA-approved TS drugs; pushed down the ladder for EPS/TD/metabolic liabilities — the opening ecopipam exploits.

rungs.label: Refractory / device
rungs.note: VMAT2 off-label (failed controlled TS trials); DBS for severe adult cases; emerging neuromodulation devices.

algorithm.ecopipam_slot: A non-antipsychotic, weight-neutral D1 antagonist positioned above the antipsychotics (and competing with alpha-2 agonists in moderate-to-severe tics) once guidelines update.

competitors.name: Aripiprazole (Abilify)
competitors.liabilities: +1.5 kg weight gain vs placebo; akathisia; EPS/TD class risk

competitors.name: Neupulse
competitors.ts_status: UK 'wellness' device launched 2026; medical version in development; no FDA clearance

ecopipam.name: Ecopipam
ecopipam.ts_status: NDA accepted with Priority Review (Aug 19, 2026); FDA target action date late Q1 2027. Pediatric-only indication. Orphan + Fast Track.
ecopipam.efficacy: Phase 3 D1AMOND (n=216 open-label; 104 randomized withdrawal): pediatric relapse HR 0.5, P=.008. Oct 2026 MDS: ~70% clinically meaningful tic reduction within 8 weeks (post hoc); 45.6% mean reduction at 18 months (open-label extension).
ecopipam.tolerability: Weight-neutral; no significant metabolic or EPS signals. AEs: somnolence ~11%, anxiety/headache ~10%, insomnia ~9%.

austedo_dynamic.title: The Teva internal portfolio question — complementary, not cannibalistic
austedo_dynamic.note: Austedo (~$1.6B in 2024) is adult tardive dyskinesia / Huntington's chorea, has no TS indication, and failed the ARTISTS trials designed to earn one. Ecopipam fills the gap Austedo left and reuses the same neuroscience/movement-disorder commercial infrastructure. Main internal tension is share-of-voice, not revenue overlap.
